description: A pair identity (`pair:<a>|<b>...`, also behind a prefix such as `cpd:`) lists its two files in path order, and the finding sits on the first. Renaming src/a/A.java to src/c/A.java moves it behind src/b/B.java, so after the rename the base key's two files are put back in path order and its path becomes the new first file; the clone and its size metric stay unchanged instead of resolved plus new.
